# IP-01 Independent Scope Review — CR-012 / FEAT34

**Current verdict: PASS**

## Initial review

**Verdict: NEEDS REVISION**

The report is materially conservative about implementation status, covers all FEAT34 acceptance criteria, inventories the defined route family, and retains the Phase 2/Phase 3, runtime/delivery, and preflight critical blockers. It does not yet pass the brief's hard gates for bidirectional source traceability and complete NFR/state-contract coverage.

## Hard-gate assessment

| Gate | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Completeness | NEEDS REVISION | API v1's required validation and rate-limit state handling is absent from the requirement/NFR inventory. |
| Bidirectional source traceability | NEEDS REVISION | Several citations use ambiguous source aliases and there is no authoritative-input-to-report coverage map. |
| Internal consistency | PASS | Proposed, blocked, and out-of-scope classifications are used consistently with the stated definition. |
| Implemented-versus-planned truthfulness | PASS | The report explicitly treats the API as candidate-not-bound and graph endpoints as specified-not-implemented; it does not claim implementation. |
| FEAT34 AC-01..AC-07 coverage | PASS | The acceptance table at `IP-01-scope-report.md:44-54` maps every AC to local requirements and agrees with FEAT34 section 6. |
| Endpoint/resource inventory | PASS | `IP-01-scope-report.md:75-90` accounts for each API v1 read/write endpoint, the protected routes, runtime transitions, and prohibited direct paths. |
| Preflight CRIT-001/002/003 | PASS | `IP-01-scope-report.md:101-108` accurately preserves the critical preflight status and distinguishes it from implementation evidence. |

## Required revision findings

1. **[P1] Make source references resolvable and prove input coverage.**
   The brief requires traceability to every authoritative input (`IP-01-brief.md:7-16`). The report uses non-unique aliases such as `Design` in `IP-01-scope-report.md:7,27-39,66` and `Agent Office` in `IP-01-scope-report.md:16,40,62,65-67`; these do not identify whether the citation is `visual-office-design-spec.md` or `visual-office-agent-office-spec.md`, and `Doc graph endpoint node` in `IP-01-scope-report.md:76,87,89` does not identify the specific graph node. Add a compact authoritative-input coverage table that maps each of the eight brief inputs (and relevant sections/nodes) to report sections/IDs, and replace aliases with exact document names plus section or exact graph-node IDs. This must support both source-to-report and report-to-source traversal.

2. **[P1] Add the missing API validation and rate-limit state requirements.**
   API v1 section 5 requires safe `422 VALIDATION_FAILED` field errors and `429 RATE_LIMITED` retry guidance, while section 4.3 requires server validation of schedules, recipients, KPI/template constraints, and the alert cap (`zuri-visual-office-api-v1.md:142-158,172-184`). The report records `409` and selected 401/403/404/503 behavior (`IP-01-scope-report.md:63-64`) but omits `422` and `429` entirely. Add a stable local requirement and/or NFR row that captures server-side validation, safe field-level UI treatment, rate-limit/retry treatment, and their no-secret/no-cross-tenant error-payload boundary. Map the deliberate UI state portion to FEAT34 AC-05 and cite API v1 sections 4.3 and 5.

## Re-review criteria

Re-review after the two findings above are addressed without changing the report's conservative implementation classifications or removing the CRIT-001/002/003 blocker treatment.
